title: Every PII-flagged column has legal_basis and retention
statement: For any column in a data-model-inventory body (Phase 17.C3) whose pii_class field is non-empty (set by inventory_data_handling's heuristics or by hand-curated stack-adapter pack overrides), both legal_basis and retention fields MUST also be non-empty strings. A column that has been classified as PII without an associated legal basis under LGPD / GDPR / HIPAA / CCPA and without a retention policy is a compliance defect by definition.
rationale: Per D-57 and the brownfield-adoption argument, DEVAI absorbs redox's LGPD compliance discipline as a core capability (Phase 17 OQ2). The inventory_data_handling sensor seeds pii_class; the Architect or stack-adapter pack supplies legal_basis + retention. This invariant makes the seeding actionable: once a PII column is flagged, the trio (pii_class + legal_basis + retention) MUST be complete before release. Severity hard-fail (Phase 10.A) reflects that this is a compliance-floor item: shipping unlabeled PII handling is a regulatory exposure, not a quality concern.

strategy.rationale: The registered test corpus provides deterministic regression evidence for this invariant.
